title: cleanCodeDiscovery
responsibility: Selects reviewable source files, separates unsupported paths and applies Git, sensitive-path, generated-source and configured exclusions.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.root
inputs.description: Repository directory: collected paths are made relative to it, and the bounded git check-ignore probe runs with it as the working directory. A file outside this directory gets a relative path that starts with '../'.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.collected
inputs.description: The output of the audit file collector: `files` holds each candidate's `path`, built with `join` from the scanned root, and its lowercase `extension` with the leading dot (empty when the name has none), while `ignoredPaths` holds artifact-directory and symlink entries that are reported as excluded. The `dirs` field is not read by this function.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.exclusions
inputs.description: Configured glob or directory-prefix patterns, each tested with matchesExclusion against collected file paths only and never against ignoredPaths entries. The test runs after the Git-ignored and sensitive-path checks and before the generated-source and source-extension checks; an empty array adds no configured exclusions.

inputs.name: matchesExclusion.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path that is compared exactly as given, with no separator or './' normalization, so it must already use '/' separators. The comparison is case-sensitive.

inputs.name: matchesExclusion.pattern
inputs.description: A glob or directory prefix where `*` matches any characters except '/', `**` matches any characters including '/', `**/` matches nothing or any leading path ending in '/', and `?` matches one character except '/', with a pattern ending in '/' matching every path that starts with it. Before matching, backslashes become '/' and one leading './' is removed.

outputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles
outputs.description: Coverage split into `selectedFiles` (source-extension files that pass every exclusion check), `unsupportedFiles` (other non-excluded files), both sorted by path, and `excludedPaths` (collector artifact and symlink entries first, then excluded files sorted by path, each with its reason). A Git probe that exits non-zero or fails with a non-timeout error adds no 'Git ignored' entries, and a timeout throws instead.

outputs.name: matchesExclusion
outputs.description: True when the whole path matches the glob or when a directory-prefix pattern is a prefix of the path. The match is case-sensitive and the path is not normalized.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by discoverCleanCodeFiles as `new Error('Cannot safely determine ignored files for clean code review.')` with the caught probe error as `cause`, only when that error has the code ETIMEDOUT. Other probe failures are not thrown and contribute no Git-ignored exclusions.
